items.title:
Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund is seeking to sell a 25% stake in Newcastle United, the Financial Times reports.
The wealth fund wants to raise capital to invest in the Premier League club's infrastructure. PIF led the club's £305 million takeover in 2021.
items.title_ja:
サウジアラビアの公共投資基金がニューカッスル・ユナイテッドの株式25％の売却を模索しているとフィナンシャル・タイムズ紙が報じた。
ウェルスファンドはプレミアリーグクラブのインフラに投資するための資金を集めたいと考えている。 PIFは2021年にクラブの3億500万ポンドの買収を主導した。

items.title:
Banks are pitching CVC on an €11 billion debt package to finance a possible takeover of Verisure, the European home-security company, Bloomberg reports.
Verisure listed in Stockholm last year.
items.title_ja:
ブルームバーグの報道によると、欧州のホームセキュリティ会社ベリシュアの買収に資金を提供するため、銀行各社がCVCに対し110億ユーロの債務パッケージを売り込んでいる。
Verisureは昨年ストックホルムに上場した。

items.title:
Todd Boehly's investment group has signed a US-backed share swap deal to buy Lukoil's global assets, Reuters reports.
The US International Development Finance Corp. will participate, though the agreement still needs US Treasury approval.
items.title_ja:
トッド・ボーリー氏の投資グループがルクオイルの世界資産を買収するため、米国の支援による株式交換契約に署名したとロイター通信が報じた。
米国国際開発金融公社も参加するが、協定には依然として米財務省の承認が必要だ。

items.title:
Anthropic shares fell to $75.70 after the open, below the top of their original $70-$78 IPO range.
The stock priced at $83 last week after strong demand pushed it above the range. It is now down 9% from that price.
items.title_ja:
アンスロピック株は寄り付き後に75.70ドルまで下落し、当初のIPOレンジの上限である70～78ドルを下回った。
旺盛な需要を受けて株価は先週83ドルでこのレンジを上回った。現在はその価格から9％下落しています。

items.title:
AI turmoil is weighing on data center dealmaking, with Blue Owl's planned $20 billion-plus sale taking a hit, Bloomberg reports.
It comes as a BlackRock-IFM group weighs a lower bid for Stack's Asia data centers and UK data center group Nscale says it could stay private.
items.title_ja:
ブルー・オウルが計画していた200億ドル以上の売却計画が打撃を受け、AIの混乱がデータセンター取引の重しになっているとブルームバーグが報じた。
これは、ブラックロックとIFMグループがスタックのアジアデータセンターの入札価格を引き下げることを検討しており、英国のデータセンターグループNscaleが非公開のままでよいと述べている中でのことだ。

items.title:
Walmart-backed PhonePe has restarted its IPO process and is eyeing a valuation of up to $15 billion in its market debut, a source told Reuters.
The Economic Times earlier reported a $12 billion to $14 billion target. PhonePe shelved its listing plans in March.
items.title_ja:
ウォルマートが支援するフォンペはＩＰＯプロセスを再開し、市場デビューで最大１５０億ドルの評価額を目指していると関係者がロイターに語った。
エコノミック・タイムズ紙は先に、目標を120億〜140億ドルと報じていた。 PhonePeは3月に上場計画を棚上げした。

items.title:
James Murdoch-backed Allen Career Institute has picked banks for an India IPO that could raise as much as $300 million, Bloomberg reports.
Neuberg Diagnostics has also picked banks for an IPO of up to $200 million, adding to India's busy listings pipeline.
items.title_ja:
ブルームバーグの報道によると、ジェームズ・マードック氏が支援するアレン・キャリア・インスティテュートは、最大3億ドルを調達できるインドのIPOの対象銀行を選定したという。
ノイバーグ・ダイアグノスティックスはまた、最大2億ドルのIPOの対象となる銀行を選定しており、インドの多忙な上場パイプラインにさらなる追加を加えている。

items.title:
Arete initiated coverage of Anthropic with a Buy rating and a $300 price target, implying about 266% upside from Tuesday's close of $81.91.
The call comes as the stock trades below its $83 IPO price.
items.title_ja:
アレテ氏はアンスロピックのカバレッジを「買い」の格付けと目標株価300ドルで開始し、火曜日の終値81.91ドルから約266％上昇することを示唆した。
この電話は、株価が83ドルのIPO価格を下回って取引されているときに発生した。

items.title:
AT&S, the Austrian maker of substrates used in AI chips, is weighing moving its stock listing from Vienna to the US or Asia, Bloomberg reports.
Its fiscal second-quarter EBITDA jumped 152% to €244 million as it expands capacity.
items.title_ja:
AIチップに使用される基板を製造するオーストリアのAT&Sは、株式上場先をウィーンから米国またはアジアに移すことを検討しているとブルームバーグが報じた。
生産能力の拡大に伴い、会計年度第2四半期のEBITDAは152%増の2億4400万ユーロとなった。

items.title:
Walmart-backed PhonePe is back in talks with bankers to revive its India IPO, targeting a valuation of $12 billion to $14 billion, the Economic Times reports.
The digital payments company shelved its listing plans in March amid global tensions and market volatility.
items.title_ja:
ウォルマートが支援するフォンペは、インドIPOの復活に向けて銀行家との交渉を再開しており、評価額120億ドルから140億ドルを目標にしているとエコノミック・タイムズ紙が報じた。
デジタル決済会社は、世界的な緊張と市場の不安定さの中、3月に上場計画を棚上げした。

items.title:
Bureau Veritas says it is not engaged in discussions with Advent International, after a report that the private equity firm is weighing a takeover.
The testing and certification group's shares are up 6.5% in Paris, paring earlier gains.
items.title_ja:
ビューロー・ベリタスは、プライベート・エクイティ会社が買収を検討しているとの報道を受けて、アドベント・インターナショナルとの協議には参加していないと述べた。
試験・認証グループの株価はパリで6.5％上昇し、これまでの上昇幅に及ばない。

items.title:
Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy is leaving the Walmart-owned company after more than 11 years, ahead of its planned IPO in India.
Chief product and technology officer Balaji Thiagarajan will lead Flipkart in the interim, the company said.
items.title_ja:
フリップカートの最高経営責任者（CEO）カリヤン・クリシュナムルシー氏は、インドで計画されているIPOを前に、11年以上勤務したウォルマート傘下の同社を退社する。
同社によると、最高製品技術責任者のバラジ・ティアガラジャン氏が暫定的にフリップカートを率いることになるという。

items.title:
Cathie Wood's ARK Invest bought about $61.6 million of Anthropic stock on Tuesday, the day shares first closed below their $83 IPO price.
Anthropic now makes up about 2% of ARK's flagship Innovation ETF, according to the fund's daily holdings.
items.title_ja:
キャシー・ウッド氏のARKインベストは火曜日にアンスロピック株を約6,160万ドルで購入したが、この日初めて株価はIPO価格の83ドルを下回って取引を終えた。
同ファンドの毎日の保有高によると、アンスロピックは現在、ARKの主力イノベーションETFの約2％を占めている。

items.title:
A consortium including BlackRock and IFM Investors is considering lowering its offer for Stack Infrastructure's Asia Pacific data centers, Bloomberg reports.
The rethink comes amid increasing volatility in the data center sector.
items.title_ja:
ブルームバーグの報道によると、ブラックロックやIFMインベスターズを含むコンソーシアムは、スタック・インフラストラクチャーのアジア太平洋データセンターへのオファーの引き下げを検討しているという。
この再考は、データセンター部門のボラティリティが高まる中で行われた。

Private equity firms are sitting on a record backlog of companies they can’t sell, and about $300 billion of debt at PE-backed companies comes due in 2028 and 2029, per the WSJ.

PE funds typically aim to exit within three to five years. According to PitchBook, 30% of holdings have now been held for six years or more, a record.

On market crashes like today, I'm reminded of a piece of advice I got from a CIO mentor that traded during the dotcom and 08 crashes and lived to tell the tale.
He said: "Treat investing the same way you treat life."
That's all. It has stuck with me for many years because after filling in the blanks, you're forced to become "better" in both portfolio management and life management. It's uncanny how correlated they are.
Strip either one down and you're left with the same raw materials: time and uncertainty.
Every investment gives up something certain today for something uncertain tomorrow. So does nearly everything that matters in life. Love, learning, raising a child, starting a new job. Anything.
Both reward patience, but only after testing it.
You can't generate performance without risking losses, the same way you can't love without risking grief.
But fundamentally, the first rule of portfolio and life management is survival.
You can come back from most losses, but not from the one that takes you out of the game.
It's always darkest before the dawn.

$DELL Vice Chairman: "there’s nothing that suggests that we're going to see price declines in enterprise NAND and DRAM for servers."
JP Morgan note:

Enterprise NAND pricing might see different rates than spot markets, as seen with Dell Chairman comments.
TLDR:
- Token spend continues to grow despite users shifting to cheaper Chinese models
- Bullish comments on DRAM duration (also seen with $AMBA earnings), but consumer demand weakening

- More nuanced for NAND, weakness in near term NAND spot markets (with expected rebound after GPUs/DRAM/components arrive), enterprise NAND markets seem resilient.

JPモルガンの注：
- OpenRouter によると、全体的なトークン支出は増加を続けました (前月比 +8% 成長) 一方で、ボリューム価格は前月比 -39% 減少しました。

- DRAM の寿命については強気のコメント ($AMBA の収益にも見られる)、しかし消費者の需要は弱まる

SOME PERSONAL THOUGHTS AHEAD OF WEEKEND
I wanted to share a few thoughts heading into the weekend because at least for me this has been one of most mentally exhausting stretches I've experienced investing in growth stocks.
And honestly one of the things I've found most difficult has very little to do with market itself since it's how much mental real estate I apparently occupy in the minds of certain "gurus" on this platform whom I've never met, followed or even spoken to.
I started sharing my thoughts on X back in 2023 simply because I genuinely love investing and wanted somewhere to talk about market, share my research and connect with people who enjoyed it as much as I did and I never imagined that would turn into an account reaching 100 million impressions every month or that I'd eventually find myself appearing on national television every week.
I'm incredibly grateful because this platform accelerated my career at a relatively young age and opened doors that otherwise might have taken me many more years to reach but I'd be lying if I said spotlight wasn't intense since the larger my audience becomes and more visible I am the more I've realized that success also seems to attract resentment from people I've never interacted with or affected in any way possible.
Daniel has a phrase for this that I think captures it perfectly because "hating up" is absolutely real especially online where people seem more comfortable attacking someone who has become visible than examining why that person's success bothers them in the first place.
Like I've had people accuse me of taking an investment idea from them despite fact that I don't follow them and have never even seen their work while others take a disagreement over a particular thesis and turn it into a personal judgment about whether I know anything about investing.
What I find especially strange is that some of these individuals are in their 40s and 50s have been doing this for decades and still seem determined to tear down a 33 year old who is simply willing to publish his research, explain what he believes and put his own money behind those convictions (I've never asked anyone to agree with me or suggested that my way of investing is the only way to succeed).
And I think that last part is important because I do all of this under my real name and face, publicly disclose what I own through my subs service, share my position sizes and actual dollars I've invested and expose myself to scrutiny over every good decision and every mistake along the way.
There's absolutely nothing wrong with choosing to remain anonymous and I respect anyone who prefers to operate that way but theres just a different level of personal accountability when people know exactly who you are and watch you explain your thesis on camera and follow your positions in real time and wait for first opportunity to use a bad outcome against you... just remember being wrong privately costs you money but being wrong publicly can also cost you reputation, confidence and peace of mind which is something I don't think people fully appreciate until they've experienced it themselves.
None of this is to suggest that criticism should be off limits because disagreement is a huge part of investing but what I truly struggle to understand is why disagreement so often has to become personal... especially during periods like this when so many people are already dealing with painful drawdowns and questioning decisions they made with the best information available to them.
Markets eventually humble every single one of us regardless of how experienced we are or how much success we've had and anyone who stays in this long enough will eventually experience a thesis that breaks or a position they sized too aggressively or a drawdown that exposes a weakness in their process or a decision they wish they could take back so that's why I think showing people grace matters so much because you never know when you'll find yourself on the other side of that experience hoping others will extend you the same understanding.
And also just remember it cost absolutely nothing to root for people, respect the work they're putting in and recognize that someone can be wrong about an investment without deserving to be ridiculed for it and I genuinely wish more people on this platform understood that being publicly wrong doesn't erase courage it takes to stand behind your own convictions in the first place.

そして正直に言うと、私が最も難しいと感じたことの1つは、市場自体とはほとんど関係がありません。それは、私が会ったことも、フォローしたことも、話したことさえない、このプラットフォーム上の特定の「達人」の心の中で私がどれだけの精神的領域を占めていると思われるかということだからです。
私が X についての考えを 2023 年に共有し始めたのは、単純に投資が心から好きで、市場について話したり、自分の研究を共有したり、同じように市場を楽しんでいる人々とつながる場所が欲しかったからです。それが毎月 1 億インプレッションに達するアカウントに成長したり、最終的には全国放送のテレビに毎週出演するようになるとは想像もしていませんでした。

Living Brain and OpenHuman say they've used AI agents with persistent memory and recursive self-improvement to solve 15 mathematical conjectures, some dating back over 100 years.
For Erdős Problem 985, Living Brain identified the exact theorem needed from a 17-million-line Lean library, allowing its AI agents to complete the proof in a single line of Lean.
What's particularly interesting is that @livingbrain operates independently of the underlying AI model, allowing ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Codex and other AI agents to access the same accumulated knowledge without repeatedly processing entire conversation histories.
In its internal evaluations:
• 92.2% accuracy on the LoCoMo memory benchmark
• Up to 22.6x fewer tokens per question
• Up to 95% lower cost per task
• 464ms median memory retrieval time
Developers can integrate the memory layer into their own AI agents via API, SDK or MCP.

Six are named conjectures that were open until 20 November, including the Lindelöf hypothesis, Erdős Problem 985 and Euler’s idoneal numbers.
